event_name: FIA Formula One World Championship Italian Grand Prix Thursday Press Conference Transcript
from: THE FLOOR Q: (Frédéric Ferret – l'Equipe) A question for Kimi and Sebastian. Can you tell us the feeling to be a Ferrari driver at Monza. And another question for Seb, what is the feeling when you win in Monza, even not for Ferrari?
title: Ita Gp Thurspressconftranscript Final
to: Sebastian and Kimi, it's more or less in the line of your last answer, Maurizio Arrivabene said that it's very important for Ferrari to push Mercedes, they are not used to it over the last four years at least – but it's also true that many people believe you have the best car, and many Italians say Ferrari has a great chance of being World Champion this year. If you go outside you hear this from many Italians. You feel this pressure that will exist?
